scope: Server-injected local assertion function; no remote provider, paid call, legal age decision or deployment.

contract.configuration: adultVerification:{required:true,issuer,verify,timeoutMs?}; server code only, no CLI or browser activation.
contract.sequence: Positive safe integer, monotonic per subject and issuer; same sequence and different content creates a persistent conflictedSequence fence that only a higher trusted result clears.
contract.persistentPolicy: The existing database-level dating_meta.adult_required bit remembers enforcement after deletion of every account document; old three-column metadata is upgraded without PII.
contract.rawPersonalData: Date of birth, ID documents, provider tokens and extra fields are rejected; only the exact minimal assertion is retained in the existing private account document.
contract.peerProjection: No private verification status or assertion.
